classification.difficultyReason: Translate positions relative to the landmark into displacement between the people, use inverse tangent and interpret the southwest bearing and its reverse.

content.prompt: Alan is standing 100 m due east of a landmark. Benny is standing 250 m due south of the landmark. What is the bearing, correct to the nearest tenth of a degree, of:

answer.worked:
From Alan, Benny is 100 m west and 250 m south. Let $\theta$ be the angle west of south.

$$\begin{align*}\tan\theta&=\frac{100}{250}\\\theta&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{100}{250}\right)\\\theta&\approx21.8014^{\circ}\end{align*}$$

Bearings are measured clockwise from north.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Bearing}&=180^{\circ}+\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{100}{250}\right)\\\text{Bearing}&\approx201.8^{\circ}\mathrm{T}\end{align*}$$

From Benny, Alan is 100 m east and 250 m north. Let $\phi$ be the angle east of north.

$$\begin{align*}\tan\phi&=\frac{100}{250}\\\phi&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{100}{250}\right)\\\phi&\approx21.8^{\circ}\end{align*}$$

The bearing of Alan from Benny is $021.8^{\circ}\mathrm{T}$.
